title: Orthodontics II: Main Exam, 14 December 2018
programme: Bachelor of Science in Dental Technology
instructions: Answer ALL questions in section A and answer ANY TWO questions from

items.text: Section A ANSWER ALL THE QUESTIONS

parts.text: Outline two requirements of an orthodontic spring.
Explain five factors which may affect anchorage in removable orthodontics.
Give four types of retentive components in removal orthodontics.
Outline four types of active components in removal orthodontic appliances.
Enumerate five advantages of removable orthodontic appliances.
Give five requirements for an ideal clasp for use in orthodontic appliances.
Outline five modifications of the Adam's clasp.

items.text: Section B ANSWER ANY TWO QUESTIONS
Describe the procedure of trimming a mandibular and a maxillary orthodontic models.
After receiving impressions, describe the procedure of fabricating an orthodontic appliance with Adam's clasps and a labial bow.

parts.text: Compare functional and fixed orthodontic appliances.
